n: Payments from or to unrelated third parties
ds: Funds are paid or received, or instructions are given to pay, through parties with no evident link to the customer, contract, debt or insured interest. Includes third-party cheques, loan repayments, premiums, gaming funds and goods payments not matching the documentation.
fp: Legitimate third-party payers exist, such as family members, parents, guarantors, payment agents or corporate treasury entities, and are usually explainable with documentation.
